blindFirstRun.conclusion: Compiled retrieval underperformed raw-folder retrieval; Graph did not justify its added token cost.

rejectedAttempt.reason: Separating and capping source metadata improved one question but reduced P-seed evidence recall from 0.393 to 0.357 and lost evidence on other tasks. It was reverted.

acceptedChange.description: Add at most eight Canonical Claims that share the same resolved source block as a lexical Seed before optional Graph traversal.

targetedAnswerValidation.before: Both compiled modes gave the prohibition date as 2 August 2024 and triggered a hard failure.
targetedAnswerValidation.after: Both compiled modes answered 2 February 2025, 2 August 2026 and 2 August 2027 with three valid citations.

remainingPrimaryDefect: Cross-language semantic retrieval remains absent. Chinese questions with no shared named entity cannot reliably retrieve English evidence, so no full post-hoc rerun is justified yet.
